entry.title: Monomodule One (Gen2) 1.0.4
entry.summary: **Pressing Stop twice can no longer cut or reset the voice.** MPC's plugin host sets the first parameter (Machine) to its maximum and back on every Stop; the voice could swap machine twice if it saw that jump. The engine now ignores that transient jump. Same download as before: nothing of Elektron's inside; put your own Elektron_SFX6-60_OS1.32B.syx in the plugin's monomodule/ folder.

entry.title: Monomodule One (Gen2) 1.0.3
entry.summary: **Lower CPU on Gen2 (MPC Live III).** The DSP and voice threads now run on the Live III's fast cores (Cortex-A76) instead of a slow Cortex-A55 core, and below MPC's own audio threads in priority so they never take time from MPC's audio engine. Measured with 8 voices held: about 8% of a core, was 31%. Gen1 (Force, MPC Live/One/X): unchanged. Audio is bit-identical (gate passed on all 22 machines). entry.title: Monomodule One (Gen2) 1.0.2
entry.summary: - **OS file check in the installer app.** Monomodule One declares its files, so the installer app's **Your ROMs and files** step checks your Monomachine OS 1.32B `.syx` (by its exact size and Elektron header) and saves it as `Elektron_SFX6-60_OS1.32B.syx` whatever it is called on your computer. Kit dumps go to `monomodule/dumps/` the same way. A kit dump is never taken as the OS file. entry.title: Monomodule One (Gen2) 1.0.1
entry.summary: **Fixes the missing skin in 1.0.0** (that release has been withdrawn). The plugin keeps its name "Monomodule One": MPC finds a plugin's skin by the plugin's name, and 1.0.0 had renamed the list entry without renaming the folder. If you installed 1.0.0: install this over it, load the plugin once (it makes its skin from your OS file) and restart MPC.
